context: A doctor and a teen reporter explore a teen-mental-health study
purpose: Teach: アイデンティティ/苦悩/根源/嫌悪/落語/教団/風俗/戦車

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生、今日は十代のメンタルヘルス調査について取材させてください。最近、自分のアイデンティティに悩む子が本当に増えてる気がしてて。
lines.en: Doctor, today I'd like to interview you about the teen mental-health study. Lately, it really feels like more kids are struggling with their identity.
lines.style: Polite but eager teen reporter tone, slightly informal ending.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: いい着眼点ですね。端的に言うと、思春期の苦悩の根源には、自分が何者なのか分からないという不安があるんです。
lines.en: That's a sharp observation. To put it plainly, at the root of adolescent anguish lies the anxiety of not knowing who one truly is.
lines.style: Calm, measured physician explaining clinical findings gently.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: なるほど…。私の友達も、鏡を見るたびに自己嫌悪に陥るって言ってて、見てて辛いんですよね。
lines.en: I see. One of my friends says she falls into self-loathing every time she looks in the mirror, and it's painful to watch.
lines.style: Sympathetic teen sharing a personal anecdote with concern.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: その嫌悪感は決して珍しくありません。調査では、SNSの影響を少なからず受けているという結果も出ています。
lines.en: That sense of revulsion is by no means rare. Our survey shows that social media influence plays a significant role.
lines.style: Professional doctor citing research data with quiet authority.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ちなみに、何かに極端にのめり込む子の話も聞きました。おじいちゃんみたいに落語にハマる子もいれば、怪しい教団に取り込まれちゃう子もいるって。
lines.en: By the way, I also heard about kids who get extremely absorbed in something. Some get into rakugo like grandpas, while others get pulled into shady religious groups.
lines.style: Curious reporter relaying secondhand stories in a casual tone.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 実際にそういう事例はありますよ。古典落語に没頭する子も、教団にすがる子も、共通点は現実からの逃避先を探していることなんです。
lines.en: Such cases really do exist. Whether a kid immerses himself in classical rakugo or clings to a religious group, the common thread is seeking an escape from reality.
lines.style: Doctor calmly listing real clinical observations without judgment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 逃避先かあ…。流行や風俗の変化って、結局そういう心の表れなんですかね?
lines.en: An escape, huh. So shifts in trends and customs are basically expressions of what's going on inside, then?
lines.style: Relatable teen reflecting thoughtfully on her peers' coping.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: まさにその通り。例えば、戦車や乗り物の模型を黙々と作る子だって、自分なりに心を守る方法を探している。風俗や趣味は若者の心の鏡なんですよ。
lines.en: Exactly so. Even a kid silently building tank or vehicle models is searching, in his own way, for how to protect his heart. Trends and hobbies are mirrors of young minds.
lines.style: Warm doctor connecting cultural trends to inner psychology.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 戦車の模型までですか(笑)。でも、確かにそれぞれの守り方があるんですね。今日のお話、すごく勉強になりました!
lines.en: Even tank models, really (laughs). But yes, everyone has their own way of protecting themselves. Today's talk was incredibly enlightening — thank you!
lines.style: Bright closing tone from teen reporter, genuinely grateful.
